prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone architectural detail reference image, landscape 16:9, Full HD 1920x1080 requested. Flat orthographic FRONT ELEVATION of ONE upper timber structural bay from a traditional Vietnamese Catholic church, isolated on a plain warm ivory background. Use attached real church photograph as the style source, specifically its large round polished brown columns, deep carved curling foliate brackets embracing the heads, strongly layered horizontal beam mouldings, a shallow arched decorative upper rail with pierced floral carving and two short upright supports, and visible sloping timber rafters above. Show the whole single upper bay, left and right column heads plus short shaft portions terminating cleanly at the bottom; not full floor-to-roof columns. Symmetric clear bay, one broad horizontal tie beam, curved carved haunches at both ends, open space above tie under shallow ornamental arched rail, a central small carved support. Rich natural chestnut wood, restrained satin sheen, detailed grain, crisp plausible carving in the SAME WOOD, no all-over gold paint. This is a proposed ornamental reconstruction for model reference, not a fabrication drawing. Front-on truly flat view, straight verticals, no perspective convergence, 5% margin, balanced even studio illumination with subtle relief shadows, high detail throughout. No dimensions, no text, no labels, no watermark, no people, no sanctuary, no smartphone UI, no collage, no multiple panels, no fans or lamps obscuring the joinery. This image establishes the master design for subsequent closeups.

Create ONE separate photorealistic architectural detail image at 1920x1080 Full HD, landscape 16:9. Reference image 1 is the MASTER DESIGN: preserve precisely its chestnut timber, round column, same scrolling foliate carving, curved haunch, layered beam edge and floral pier above. Reference image 2 supplies real material and construction atmosphere only. Show a close three-quarter view of the LEFT COLUMN HEAD and its junction with the transverse tie beam and the perpendicular longitudinal beam, seen at 35 degrees from the nave, very slightly upward. Crop tightly around this one joint, with enough column shaft below and both beam returns to make its depth legible. Preserve same arrangement and ornamental vocabulary as the master. Show clear end shoulders, layered moulding returns and deep undercut carving, convincing connected timber volumes, no exploded parts, no technical claims or invented exposed steel fittings. Dark honey-chestnut polished natural wood, neutral soft diffuse daylight and subtle raking light to reveal depth without harsh glare. Isolated warm ivory background, no entire church, no sanctuary, no fans, no people, no text, no dimension lines, no border, no collage. High sharp detail on all relevant joint surfaces, no blurred foreground. Ornamental concept reference, not a fabrication drawing.

ONE separate landscape 16:9 Full HD 1920x1080 architectural close-up image. The attached master timber bay is authoritative for design, wood color and carving. Show ONLY its LEFT curved supporting bracket / haunch beneath the main horizontal tie beam where it embraces the round column, viewed obliquely from BELOW and from the inside of the bay. Camera looks upward about 25 degrees, close enough to inspect carved leaf edges, pierced recesses, the curved solid timber core under the ornament, the collar around the cylindrical column and stepped beam soffit mouldings. Same brown chestnut satin wood, same flowing leaf and floral ornament, no gilding, no new motifs or animals. Include short portions of column, beam underside and carved head to locate the part; no whole bay. Neutral ivory studio surroundings, soft broad light plus gentle side light, sharp high detail, no lens flare or blown highlights, no people, no fans, no text, no dimensions, no annotations, no collage. Visual concept detail for 3D modeling, not an engineered joinery section.

Create ONE standalone full-HD 1920x1080 landscape 16:9 architectural close-up. Use the attached generated upper-bay master as the SAME design, with real church photo as secondary reference for timber roof layers. Focus on the UPPER RAIL / SHORT UPRIGHT / SLOPING RAFTER CONNECTION above one tie beam. Three-quarter side view, camera near joint height looking slightly up, showing the short rectangular upright decorated with a carved flower panel, its moulded foot standing on the horizontal tie, the shallow curved upper rail resting on the upright, pierced floral crest above it, and the roof rafter, purlin and timber boarding immediately behind. Preserve chestnut wood and master design proportions, wood-only floral carving, no gold, no extra unrelated structural members, no disconnected floating components. Make the rear-to-front layering legible with precise shadows, wood grain, satin highlights and enough exposed side faces. Tight architectural detail composition with all key meeting surfaces sharp, ivory neutral background visible through openings, soft diffuse light. No dimensions, no text, no labels, no exploded diagram, no collage, no human, no phone interface, no fans or bright spotlights. This is a proposed ornamental visual reference, not verified concealed structural joinery.

CORRECT the attached generated concept. ONE flat FRONT ELEVATION of a COMPLETE FULL-WIDTH Vietnamese Catholic church transverse TIMBER FRAME, including CENTRAL NAVE AND BOTH SIDE AISLES. Full HD 1920x1080 landscape 16:9. Essential: FOUR visible round column shafts, two tall inner columns bounding central nave and two shorter outer columns at far left and far right bounding lower side aisles. Beams visibly CONTINUE OUTWARD from both inner column heads all the way to the outer left and right columns. Do NOT show only the central two-column portal. The left and right aisle beams are substantial, with the same layered mouldings and carved curved supporting brackets at their column junctions; show shorter upright supports and lower sloping aisle rafters above each side bay. Central nave retains the higher shallow carved arch rail, pierced floral crest, tie beam, and higher pitched roof. A continuous intelligible central-high / side-low transverse section silhouette, clearly see ALL THREE BAYS. Use the real church photograph for this multi-bay structural hierarchy. Match the generated master's natural chestnut timber and flowing carved floral ornament, no gold. Orthographic, front-on, no vanishing point, no perspective foreshortening. Entire full-width upper assembly fits inside image with 6% margin; include column shaft portions only so details are large, not full height columns or floor. Plain ivory background, studio lighting, no wall hiding lateral beams, no people, no text, no dimensions, no labels, no collage. This is a visual reconstruction of visible ornamental structure, not a construction drawing.

Create ONE standalone 1920x1080 landscape 16:9 detailed architectural image. Attached image is the authoritative full-width timber frame design. Show a THREE-QUARTER CLOSE VIEW of the RIGHT INNER COLUMN JUNCTION including BOTH the HIGH CENTRAL BEAM entering from LEFT and LOWER SIDE-AISLE BEAM continuing to RIGHT toward the visible outer round column. Also show the LONGITUDINAL BEAM continuing into depth along the inner column line, so the viewer understands that beams extend to the sides and along the church. The lower side-aisle horizontal beam must be fully visible reaching the outer column, with curved carved haunches at both ends and a short ornamental upright supporting the sloping aisle rafter above. Keep the upper central beam fragment visible left so connection of center and side is unambiguous. Frame from middle of column shafts to roof underside, 30-degree oblique view from side aisle toward nave, no walls hiding connection. Faithfully retain natural chestnut wood, same foliate carving and layered beam mouldings as master, solid connected structural volumes. Neutral ivory background, crisp fine detail, soft even illumination, realistic depth and grain, no people, no fans, no lamps, no text, no annotations, no dimension lines, no split panels or collage.
